summary: Closed PF frozen-history ordinals k384..k399 exactly (16/16). Durable lessons: command palette/templates, intent recognizers and handlers require one validated contract; broad agentic routing can hijack deterministic intents; typed and PTT input should converge on one effect gateway; mutable user/runtime DB state and secrets must be separated from source-control/research artifacts; portability cannot rely on developer paths; event-loop performance fixes need rollback evidence; retries and success notifications must be terminal-state truthful.

coordinator_handoff.rule: Mark terminal subject to conceptual dedup. Security lineage preserves only existence/class of historical secret exposure, never credential payload. No global percentage/earned-hours added here.
